0.name: TEXT_REGROC2FORGOTTENKNIGHT_00278_GIBRILLONT_000_000
0.description: Always a pleasure to greet a new customer. Something I can do for you, friend?

1.name: TEXT_REGROC2FORGOTTENKNIGHT_00278_GIBRILLONT_000_001
1.description: Your friend's garnered a fair bit of attention, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Suppose it's the novelty. Some folk haven't ever seen a Lalafell. Anyway, what'll it be?

2.name: TEXT_REGROC2FORGOTTENKNIGHT_00278_GIBRILLONT_000_002
2.description: You meet all sorts of people in this line of work. Good, bad─they've all got their reasons. You too, I suppose.

3.name: TEXT_REGROC2FORGOTTENKNIGHT_00278_GIBRILLONT_000_003
3.description: Suppose I ought to reinforce the doors in case the good ser thinks to grace us with his presence once more...

4.name: TEXT_REGROC2FORGOTTENKNIGHT_00278_GIBRILLONT_000_004
4.description: Shame Mistress Tataru had to move on. Had grown rather accustomed to having her around.

5.name: TEXT_REGROC2FORGOTTENKNIGHT_00278_GIBRILLONT_000_005
5.description: And there I thought we'd have to make do without her! Don't know how long she'll stick, but we're glad to have her back.

6.name: TEXT_REGROC2FORGOTTENKNIGHT_00278_GIBRILLONT_000_006
6.description: Some folk just can't let go of the past, whereas others can't wait to bury it.

7.name: TEXT_REGROC2FORGOTTENKNIGHT_00278_GIBRILLONT_000_007
7.description: We've got a collection going for the families that lost their homes. Might surprise you to learn that a good many contributions come from the Brume. Not that they can spare much, but they know better than anyone up above how rough it is down below.

8.name: TEXT_REGROC2FORGOTTENKNIGHT_00278_GIBRILLONT_000_008
8.description: Raise a glass to the lost, and we poor bastards who can't forget them. Aye, I know─it was a foolish plan, doomed from the start. But there ain't a man here who doesn't understand.

9.name: TEXT_REGROC2FORGOTTENKNIGHT_00278_GIBRILLONT_000_009
9.description: ...Never heard of a peace conference ending with a mob chanting for someone's death. Gods help us if we hold a third.

10.name: TEXT_REGROC2FORGOTTENKNIGHT_00278_GIBRILLONT_000_010
10.description: ...They've come, have they? Well, don't you worry about me and mine. I can still wield a blade if the battle spills into the city.

11.name: TEXT_REGROC2FORGOTTENKNIGHT_00278_GIBRILLONT_000_011
11.description: When I heard the Horde was at the gates, I let folk take shelter here at the Knight. Those were a tense few hours─even a few cups of wine couldn't dull the edge of fear for some...

12.name: TEXT_REGROC2FORGOTTENKNIGHT_00278_GIBRILLONT_000_012
12.description: And then came the news of your victory over Nidhogg. My ears still ring from the deafening cheer that went up from every throat in the room. I swear they meant you to hear it out there on the bridge!

13.name: TEXT_REGROC2FORGOTTENKNIGHT_00278_GIBRILLONT_000_013
13.description: Recently, the call went out for able hands to help rebuild, and a bunch of our regulars took up the cause. When I find a moment, I'll take them a little something to wet their whistle.

16.name: TEXT_REGROC2FORGOTTENKNIGHT_00278_A1_000_002
16.description: What kind of place is this?

18.name: TEXT_REGROC2FORGOTTENKNIGHT_00278_GIBRILLONT_000_050
18.description: Being that it's my tavern, I suppose I can do whatever I please. For the most part, I dispense drinks and advice, as the situation warrants.

19.name: TEXT_REGROC2FORGOTTENKNIGHT_00278_GIBRILLONT_000_051
19.description: Wasn't always so. I did my duty, took my wounds, and hung up my shield, as did the owner before me. You might call it a tradition.

20.name: TEXT_REGROC2FORGOTTENKNIGHT_00278_GIBRILLONT_000_052
20.description: They say that the ser who built this tavern was happy to be forgotten. “Rather serve ale instead of steel.” Had a way with words, he did─and with women. But that's a story for another time.

21.name: TEXT_REGROC2FORGOTTENKNIGHT_00278_GIBRILLONT_000_100
21.description: Of all the taverns in all of Ishgard, <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503> walks into mine...

22.name: TEXT_REGROC2FORGOTTENKNIGHT_00278_GIBRILLONT_000_101
22.description: And there I was thinking you already knew...

23.name: TEXT_REGROC2FORGOTTENKNIGHT_00278_GIBRILLONT_000_110
23.description: The Forgotten Knight is just another place for travelers and locals alike to partake of food and drink.

24.name: TEXT_REGROC2FORGOTTENKNIGHT_00278_GIBRILLONT_000_111
24.description: Upstairs, you're like to find more well-to-do regulars mingling with travelers. Downstairs, well, that's where you'll find the locals.

25.name: TEXT_REGROC2FORGOTTENKNIGHT_00278_GIBRILLONT_000_112
25.description: Right or wrong, people have a habit of sticking with their own, and Ishgardians are no different.

26.name: TEXT_REGROC2FORGOTTENKNIGHT_00278_GIBRILLONT_000_113
26.description: They've got different tastes, to say the least, but we try to cater to them all as best we can.
